name: headlessmode
description: Headless Mode - storefront site for the studio's software products and free open tools

scripts.test:a11y: echo 'Note: Install from Windows PowerShell to use pa11y-ci' && pa11y-ci --config .pa11yci.json

notes.wsl-install: Due to WSL/Windows path limitations, run 'npm install' from Windows PowerShell in the mounted path, not from WSL bash
notes.build:css: Runs before `hugo` in both scripts/build.sh and CI (.github/workflows/deploy-production.yml). Outputs themes/headlessmode/static/css/tailwind.css which Hugo serves as /css/tailwind.css. Replaces the prior cdn.tailwindcss.com runtime JIT.
